new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Performance and Quality
new_roles.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

As the Senior Manager, Performance and Quality, you'll lead proposal development and formal client responses for the account, and coordinate the team's responses to client, external, and government audits. You'll turn complex contract, pricing, performance guarantee, and operational requirements into accurate, persuasive, on-time submissions. Every commitment and audit response you produce is supported, traceable, and clear to the client. In Finance and Contract Compliance, you'll link what proposals promise to how performance and quality are checked through audits and corrective action. You will also project-manage implementations and changes on the account.

**Primary responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Develop proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, client-requested program and benefit-change proposals, and contract amendments that align with account objectives and client requirements.
* Manage the end-to-end development and submission of proposals and formal client responses, from requirement intake through final review and delivery.
* Partner with account, executive, Finance, Legal, Clinical, and Operations leadership to define key messages and value propositions, and confirm that pricing, performance guarantee, and contract commitments are accurate and approved before submission.
* Write clear, persuasive, client-ready narratives and executive communications about capabilities, program results, and positions, and represent the team in client meetings on proposals and deliverables.
* Lead project management for implementations and account changes, such as new programs, vendor transitions, and benefit or system changes. Build and manage project plans for these and for RFPs, renewals, contract amendments, client deliverables, and audit responses, with timelines, milestones, owners, and dependencies. Plan for compressed client turnaround times and escalate at-risk items early.
* Research client needs, program developments, and market and competitive trends to inform proposal strategy and client recommendations.
* Implement standardized templates, content libraries, style guides, and quality checklists for proposals and audit responses, and train contributors to use them.
* Support contract negotiations during RFPs and amendments by coordinating redlines and negotiating items with Legal and leadership, and documenting each decision to keep, trade, or drop an item, with its approver, so the rationale stays on record.
* Own the audit request log and coordinate intake, scoping, ownership, and evidence production for client, external, and government audits of the account, including third-party audits triggered by performance guarantee escalation provisions.
* Perform quality reviews of audit responses and evidence packages to confirm every part of the request is addressed, amounts reconcile, and the response is clear to an independent reviewer; coordinate secure submission and retain final versions.
* Maintain internal corrective action plans (CAPs) for known contract breaches, so completed fixes are documented before the client asks, and lead the response when the client invokes the contract's formal CAP process. Track audit findings, management responses, fixes, and closeout against contract timelines, and report recurring performance and quality themes to leadership.

**Key deliverables**
--------------------

* Proposal and client-response calendar, plus a project plan for each RFP, renewal, contract amendment, implementation, and major account change.
* Proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, and client-requested proposals.
* Standard content library, templates, style guide, and quality checklist.
* Commitment and negotiating-items log tying each commitment and redline decision to its approver and source.
* Audit request log, scope and ownership matrix, and evidence-package standards.
* Internal CAP register for known contract breaches, plus a findings, management-response, and corrective-action tracker and audit closeout packages.
* Leadership summaries of open proposals, implementation and change status, at-risk deliverables, and audit status.

***\*\*\*This is a remote role, but the ideal candidate will live in the Eastern Time Zone\*\*\****

**Minimum qualifications**

* 7+ years of work experience.
* Experience managing end-to-end proposal or RFP responses for complex healthcare or PBM clients.
* Experience planning, executing, and delivering across concurrent deadlines and owners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and proposal content-management tools.

**Preferred qualifications**

* PBM, health plan, or government program experience, including implementations or vendor transitions.
* Experience coordinating audits, regulatory requests, or evidence-based client reviews.
* Experience validating pricing, performance guarantee, or contract commitments in proposals.
* Proposal management or project management certification.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$67,900.00 - $182,549.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

 
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

 
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/14/2026

In addition to the responsibilities below, this position is also responsible for overseeing the management of doctoral candidates; monitoring post-graduate relationships across teams (e.g., performing interviews, signing off on clinical notes); aligning expectations for and making decisions regarding performing and recommending psychological tests and batteries, ensuring understanding across teams; implementing standards for processing referrals and assignments of assessment and/or testing cases; providing expertise on clinical documentation required for patient medical leave; overseeing testing systems; creating workflows; and driving effective review and approval of patient time off work requests to ensure accordance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

 
 

* Creates and advocates for developmental opportunities for others; builds collaborative, cross-functional relationships. Solicits and acts on performance feedback; works with leaders and employees to set goals and provide open feedback and coaching to drive performance improvement. Pursues professional growth; hires, trains, and develops talent for growth opportunities; strategically evaluates talent for succession planning; sets performance management guidelines and expectations across teams / units. Oversees implementation, adapts, and stays up to date with organizational change, challenges, feedback, best practices, processes, and industry trends; shares best practices within and across teams. Fosters open dialogue amongst team members, engages, motivates, and promotes collaboration within and across teams; motivates teams to meet business objectives. Delegates tasks and decisions as appropriate; provides appropriate support, guidance and scope; encourages development and consideration of options in decision making; fosters access to stakeholders.
* Manages designated units or teams by translating business plans into tactical action items; oversees the completion of work assignments and identifies opportunities for improvement; ensures all policies and procedures are followed; partners with key stakeholders and business leaders to ensure products and/or services meet requirements and expectations while aligning with departmental strategies. Aligns team efforts; builds accountability for and measuring progress in achieving results; assumes responsibility for decision making; fosters direct reports to resolve escalated issues as appropriate. Communicates goals and objectives; incorporates resources, costs, and forecasts into team and unit plans; ensures matrixed resources are fulfilling service or performance requirements across reporting lines. Removes obstacles that impact performance; identifies and addresses improvement opportunities; guides performance and develops contingency plans accordingly; influences teams and units to operate in alignment with operational and business objectives.

* Drives program development and management by: planning and coordinating adjustments to current therapy programs and future program implementation (e.g., in-/out-patient psychotherapy, chemical dependency) or new programs to enhance quality and effectiveness of services; building new systems and processes for outcome management as well as overseeing the implementation of improvements to clinical treatment programs, designs, or protocols; and analyzing the productivity of large, complex therapy programs for providers and ensuring the optimal utilization of programs.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager - Technology Operations Engineering
new_roles.description:
Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

We are seeking an experienced and technically strong **Senior Manager – Technology Operations Engineering** to lead Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Application Production Support, and operational excellence for enterprise Contact Center Transformation platforms.

This role will be responsible for ensuring the **end-to-end availability, reliability, performance, scalability, and operational stability** of mission-critical voice platforms, contact center applications, cloud-native services, intelligent voice bots, and AI-powered customer engagement solutions.

The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP), SRE practices, enterprise application support, Five9, Genesys, telephony technologies, full-stack observability, distributed tracing, and incident management** . The role also requires knowledge of emerging technologies, including Agentic AI frameworks, AI agent monitoring, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

The Senior Manager will lead engineering teams responsible for 24x7 production support, proactive monitoring, incident resolution, problem management, change management, automation, and continuous reliability improvements across complex, distributed contact center ecosystems.

 

* **Education & Professional Experience:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with **10+ years of experience** in Technology Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, Application Production Support, or Cloud Engineering, including **5+ years in technical leadership or engineering management roles** .

* **Site Reliability Engineering & Application Support:** Extensive hands-on experience in **SRE, enterprise application production support, distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, application performance troubleshooting, service reliability, and 24x7 production operations** , including on-call support and critical incident resolution.

* **Google Cloud Platform (Mandatory):** Strong hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** and cloud-native technologies, including GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Pub/Sub, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, API Gateway, cloud networking, load balancing, and containerized application environments.

* **Contact Center & Telephony Expertise:** Proven experience supporting **Five9, Genesys, or similar enterprise contact center platforms** , with a strong understanding of telephony architecture, SIP, RTP, IVR, ACD, CTI, call routing, intelligent voice bots, and contact center integrations. Experience with SpeechMiner or comparable speech analytics platforms is highly desirable.

* **Full-Stack Observability & Distributed Tracing:** Strong experience with **Grafana, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, centralized logging, application performance monitoring, and cloud observability tools** , including the ability to implement end-to-end monitoring and troubleshoot complex distributed application issues.

* **AI, Agentic AI & MCP Technologies:** Experience or strong working knowledge of **conversational AI, intelligent voice bots, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, AI agent monitoring, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers** , including AI workflow observability, execution tracing, integration troubleshooting, and operational reliability.

* **Incident, Problem & Change Management:** Demonstrated expertise in **ITIL-based Incident, Problem, and Change Management** , including major incident leadership, root cause analysis, production change coordination, escalation management, on-call operations, and continuous service improvement.

* **Database & Application Integration Technologies:** Hands-on experience supporting **NoSQL databases, Google Cloud Firestore, Oracle Database, APIs, middleware, and distributed application architectures** , with strong troubleshooting capabilities across database performance, connectivity, transaction processing, and enterprise integrations.

* **Networking, Infrastructure & Automation:** Strong understanding of **TCP/IP, DNS, HTTPS, SIP/RTP, firewalls, load balancers, traffic routing, cloud networking, Kubernetes, and containerized environments** , along with experience in automation, scripting, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as Python, Bash, or Terraform.

* **Technical Leadership & Operational Excellence:** Proven ability to lead engineering teams, manage complex production environments, collaborate across technology organizations, and drive **SRE maturity, operational automation, observability improvements, incident reduction, service reliability, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous engineering excellence** , supported by strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Factory Engineering
new_roles.description:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.

At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager, Factory Engineering position is responsible for managing the engineering activities relating to the factory and provide professional engineering and strategic technical leadership in the Factory, ensuring people health and safety, product safety and environment are never compromised. Strategic leader for engineering function, leveraging Nestle’s leadership principles in the following areas; capital execution, asset maintenance and utilities excellence, engineering compliance, and sustainability.

**JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define and propose the Factory Engineering team’s plans and objectives, and monitor their implementation in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles, and Key Engineering Activities outlined in the Nestlé Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document.
* Live Nestle leadership principles in all aspects of the role.
* Set the technical strategic vision for the factory, leveraging other functional leaders and cascade objectives to all leaders in engineering department, within factory cost targets.
* Develop and maintain technical competencies at the factory, including detailed action plans, accountability to progress, talent review, career and succession planning.
* Drive equipment reliability through implementing maintenance foundations in TPM.
* Build cooperation and collaboration with the production and other cross functional teams to build world class operation.
* Improve maintenance cost structure by improving technical skill sets and optimizing 3rd party spend.
* Implement Nestle capital process to drive excellence in capital execution.
* Proactively develop, maintain and execute the capital market business strategy (MBS) to align with the business needs.
* Drive factory master planning to facilitate long term strategies across the factory for example in Safety, Quality and Warehouse.
* Ensure full compliance with all governing bodies for utilities system relevant to the Modesto site. This is paramount and non-negotiable to have strong understanding in these utilities systems.
* Maintain reliability through implementing maintenance foundations and TPM methodology.
* Develop and maintain all skillset necessary for internal management of utilities systems.
* Drive and execute plant sustainability objectives in line with market targets.
* Drive world class water management in the factory.
* Drive reliability in all electrical components in the factory.
* Ensure full compliance with Nestle standards including calibration.
* Develop technical skills in maintenance to ensure electrical reliability.
* Drive Innovation/Renovation, initiating/coordinating implementation of new processes/technology with relevant Market, Product Technology Center, Corporate and Strategic Business Unit.
* Cascade objectives to all leaders in alignment with factory objectives, and implement the strategic technical OMP and factory master plan.
* Develop a detailed cost management plan for all aspects of engineering, including year-over-year improvements.
* Develop a detailed action plan for all aspects of technical execution.
* Implement Maintenance Foundations and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) practices.
* Leverage corporate resources and ensure compliance with Nestlé Market standards.

**EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s Degree (BA/BS) is required, preferably in Engineering, including Mechanical, Chemical, or Process. Experience would be considered in lieu of a degree.

**EXPERIENCE & SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

* At least 10 years of related work experience is highly preferred with at least 3+ years of leadership/management experience.
* Knowledge of food safety, regulatory requirements for food safety and hygienic engineering (OSH&R) preferred.
* Strong understanding of, or ability to learn, the full scope of role responsibilities, including financial analysis and key business drivers such as: Nestlé Standard Costing, Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM), CAPEX budgeting and preparation (CIAT), and Industrial Services/Energy Management (NEMT).
* Familiarity with TPM and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency with AutoCAD, Visio, CDM, AMM, ESAT, CIAT, NEMT and similar technical tools/systems.
* Demonstrated technical and managerial capabilities with in depth knowledge of food processing plant operations, technologies, utilities, maintenance systems, and hygienic engineering requirements (OSH&R).
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to apply root cause analysis and technical creativity to resolve complex short and long term issues.
* Effective communication and networking skills, with the ability to perform under pressure and in ambiguous environments.
* Experience in Project Engineering/Management, including plant design and construction.

Salary: $160,000.00 to $185,000.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace. 
 
To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Prior to the next step in the recruiting process, we welcome you to inform us confidentially if you may require any special accommodations in order to participate fully in our recruitment experience. Contact us at accommodations@nestle.com or please dial 711 and provide this number to the operator: 1-800-321-6467.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Review our applicant privacy notice before applying at https://www.nestlejobs.com/privacy.

new_roles.title: VP, Manufacturing - Fresh Bakery
new_roles.description:
**Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.**

**Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.**

**Why Campbell’s…**

* Benefits begin on day one and include medical, dental, short and long-term disability, AD&D, and life insurance (for individual, families, and domestic partners).
* Employees are eligible for our matching 401(k) plan and can enroll on the first day of employment with immediate vesting.
* Campbell’s offers unlimited sick time along with paid time off and holiday pay.
* If in WHQ – free access to the fitness center. Access to on-site day care (operated by Bright Horizons) and company store.
* Giving back to the communities where our employees work and live is very important to Campbell’s. Our “Campbell’s Cares” program matches employee donations and/or volunteer activity up to $1,500 annually.
* Campbell’s has a variety of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support employees.

**Job Description**

The Vice President, Manufacturing – Fresh Bakery provides strategic and operational leadership for Campbell’s Fresh Bakery manufacturing network, including bakery operations in Bloomfield, Connecticut; Downers Grove, Illinois; Lakeland, Florida; and Denver, Pennsylvania. This leader establishes the manufacturing strategy, operating priorities, performance expectations, and transformation agenda for the network, ensuring consistent execution across safety, quality, service, cost, reliability, productivity, and people.

Leading through the Plant Managers, the VP creates alignment across sites while maintaining clear site-level accountability for day-to-day operations and results. The role builds manufacturing capability and organizational talent across the network, identifies and addresses systemic performance opportunities, and drives continuous improvement and transformation to strengthen the long-term competitiveness of the Fresh Bakery business.

This leader partners across Supply Chain and the broader organization to align manufacturing strategy, capabilities, capacity, capital priorities, and resources with business needs. The incumbent must be an enterprise-minded business partner who creates direction, enables effective decisions, builds talent and culture, drives disciplined execution, and owns results across the network.

**Essential Job Duties**

**Manufacturing Strategy & Network Leadership:** Define and lead the multi-year manufacturing strategy for the Fresh Bakery network. Translate business and Supply Chain priorities into clear site objectives, integrated roadmaps, operating plans, and performance expectations. Maintain clarity between network-level strategic direction and Plant Manager ownership of daily site operations.

**Safety, Quality & Operating Integrity:** Set expectations and governance for employee safety, food safety, product quality, environmental responsibility, and regulatory compliance across all bakery sites. Ensure effective management systems, standards, controls, and escalation routines are in place, while holding Plant Managers accountable for site execution and results.

**Network Performance Management & Accountability:** Establish the operating cadence and performance-management system for safety, quality, service, cost, labor, yield, waste, reliability, customer service, and employee engagement. Review performance across sites, identify systemic gaps and best practices, define corrective actions, and ensure clear ownership and follow-through.

**Manufacturing Transformation & Operational Excellence:** Lead the transformation agenda for Fresh Bakery manufacturing, creating consistent operating systems, standards, and management routines across the network. Build a culture of continuous improvement and zero loss, and use Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance, equipment reliability, and problem-solving disciplines to deliver sustainable improvements.

**Cost, Productivity & Business Performance:** Deliver network productivity, cost, waste, and efficiency commitments through disciplined planning and execution. Connect operational performance to financial outcomes, evaluate trade-offs, and mobilize cross-site resources to address significant performance gaps or opportunities.

**Capacity, Capability & Capital Strategy:** Shape network capacity, capability, technology, and capital priorities based on demand, growth, service, risk, and long-term business needs. Sponsor major capital and capability initiatives, ensure disciplined prioritization and governance, and partner with Engineering and other functions to achieve intended business outcomes.

**Talent, Leadership & Culture%:** Build a strong and diverse manufacturing leadership pipeline across the Fresh Bakery network. Coach and develop Plant Managers and senior site leaders; strengthen succession, bench strength, workforce planning, engagement, and retention; and create a high-performing culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

**Cross-Functional & Enterprise Partnership:** Partner with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Research & Development, Commercial, Finance, People & Culture, and other stakeholders to align priorities, solve network constraints, support innovation and commercialization, manage risk, and deliver enterprise outcomes. Serve as the senior manufacturing voice for the Fresh Bakery business.

**Required Education & Skills**

· Bachelor's degree strongly preferred or an Associate's degree with significant experience.

· Fresh Bakery manufacturing experience strongly preferred

· 15+ years of progressive manufacturing/operations experience

· Prior experience as a Plant Manager, General Manager, Director of Site Operations, or comparable senior manufacturing leader

· Significant people leadership experience, including leadership of senior operational leaders

· Demonstrated manufacturing leadership experience

· Multi-site leadership experience, likely something I'd make required or strongly preferred

**Preferred Experienc** e

· Multi-site manufacturing leadership experience, including leadership through Plant Managers or comparable senior site leaders.

· Experience in food manufacturing or consumer packaged goods (CPG) within a complex, high-volume manufacturing network.

· Demonstrated experience leading large-scale manufacturing transformation and operational excellence, with a track record of driving sustainable improvements in safety, quality, service, cost, reliability, and productivity.

· Experience applying Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), reliability, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies at scale.

· Experience developing manufacturing network strategy, including capacity, asset utilization, capital investment, and long-term capability planning.

· Demonstrated experience developing senior manufacturing leaders and building succession and bench strength across multiple operations.

· Experience managing significant operating budgets, productivity commitments, capital investments, and/or P&L responsibility.

· Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to work across Planning, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Procurement, Finance, Commercial, R&D, and People & Culture to deliver business outcomes.

· Advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

This role requires regular work in manufacturing environments and a visible presence across bakery facilities, including walking, standing, climbing stairs, and accessing production, warehouse, and office areas. The incumbent must be able to wear required personal protective equipment and work a flexible schedule as business needs require.

**Travel**

This role requires **at least 75% travel** , primarily to Campbell’s Fresh Bakery manufacturing sites and Headquarters. Regular and sustained on-site presence is expected to provide visible leadership, build strong partnerships with Plant Managers and site leadership teams, understand operating conditions firsthand, and support execution of manufacturing priorities and transformation initiatives

 

**Compensation and Benefits:**

The target base salary range for this full-time, salaried position is between

$221,500-$304,600

Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. Total pay may include other forms of compensation. In addition, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Partner for more information about our total rewards package.

**The Company is committed to providing equal opportunity for employees and qualified applicants in all aspects of the employment relationship, including consideration for employment, without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, marital status, protected veteran status, disability, age, religion, or any other classification protected by law.**

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
We are seeking a Plant Manager to join our growing team! You will oversee the activities of a production plant, milling operations, and site facilities.

Join our dynamic group and become part of a motivated team committed to making a meaningful impact in the industry, with resources to help you succeed and grow.

**Department**: Operations

**Reports** **to**: COO

**Responsibilities:**

**Join Our Team!**

Sunbelt Rentals strives to be the customer's first choice in the equipment rental industry. From pumps to scaffolding to general construction tools, we aim to be the only call needed to outfit a job site with the proper equipment. Not only do we offer a vast fleet that ranks among the best in the industry, we pair it all with a friendly and knowledgeable staff. Our employees are our greatest asset, and although we present a comprehensive equipment offering, our expertise and service are what truly distinguish us from the competition.

We pride ourselves on investing in our workforce and offer competitive benefits, as well as extensive on-the-job training for all eligible employees.

As a highly successful national company, we are constantly looking for talented individuals to support our growth. If you are interested in pursuing a rewarding career, we invite you to review our opportunities!

**Job Description Summary**

Position Objective: 
The General Manager, Manufacturing oversees all aspects of manufacturing processes to ensure proven product functionality with a sustainable return on investment (ROI). The General Manager Manufacturing manages subordinate staff and coordinates with remote departments that are responsible for engineering development and manufacturing engineering. This candidate must have proven supervisory and technical skills, and an appreciation for the complex nature of the rental HVAC industry. Personal skills that will be required include exceptional business foresight, superlative communication skills, working knowledge of several engineering disciplines and how they relate to one another, and an aptitude for managing risk.

Position Responsibilities: 

* Develops and promotes a “Zero Harm Safety Culture” leveraging Sunbelt’s Engage for Life Safety programs, fine tuning safety policy as it relates to manufacturing operations
* Has overall financial responsibility of local manufacturing operation, inventory, budgeting, cost controls, capital equipment acquisition and manufacturing facilities
* In partnership with senior management, develops and implements manufacturing plans support growth, safety and manufacturing efficiencies
* Develops the manufacturing management team, inspiring leadership through empowerment, coaching and accountability
* Develops manufacturing forecast and roughcut capacity plans
* Communicates with fleet planning, coordinating changing priorities and product deliveries
* Utilizes proven continuous improvement strategies to refine manufacturing processes and products, that minimize scrap, reduce rework & line failures and has emphasis on building the highest quality equipment at the lowest costs
* Establishes, implements, and maintains administrative policies, procedures, and standards
* Ensures production facility adheres to all local, national laws, including labor and environmental
* Develops long-term strategic initiatives for manufacturing operations
* Maintains knowledge of new trends, developments, technologies, materials, and best practices; applies this knowledge to continually improve product lines and production efficiency

Requirements: 
Education & Experience: 

* Degree in Business Administration or a related field
* 5+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operation (metal fabrication & production assembly environments experience preferred)
* Possesses knowledge and understanding of manufacturing processes and systems, engineering systems, and product inventory management, manufacturing accounting and ERP systems
* Analytical and mathematical mind, capable of evaluating and solving various complex problems
* Leadership skills necessary to manage several experienced and driven teams, including proven supervisory and technical skills
* Self-motivated attitude with the ability to multitask and thrive in a timeline-driven environment
* Interpersonal communication skills with expertise in distilling complicated topics to a broader

Base Pay Range: $108,430.00 - 149,091.80

Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. Please visit https://www.sunbeltrentals.com/careers/ for more information on our benefits and to join our Talent Network. 
 
Sunbelt also provides a comprehensive benefits package to its full-time employees. This package includes:

* Health, Dental and Vision plans
* 401(k) Match
* Volunteer time off
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Accident, Life and Travel insurance, as well as flexible spending
* Tuition Reimbursement Options
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Length of Service Awards

You will become eligible for benefits on the first of the month following 30 days from your start date. Sunbelt offers team members the following paid time off from work, subject to Sunbelt’s policies (unless specified in a collective bargaining agreement):

* 12-25 vacation days depending on years of service
* 5 sick days
* 6 holidays
* 2 half day holidays
* 2 floating holidays
* 1 inclusion day
* 1 volunteer day

Gear up for an exciting career! 
 
Sunbelt Rentals supports service members. Veterans encouraged to apply.

The Plant Manager is responsible for the management, planning, and coordination of all precast manufacturing operations to meet DVP business goals, while providing leadership to all plant and yard personnel.

* Track key performance metrics and hold direct reports accountable for results
* Ensure all production and yard operations meet DVP quality control standards
* Track and manage the inventory levels of finished goods
* Oversee and manage all incoming materials to ensure adequate inventory levels are met
* Continually collect and review data to reduce inefficiencies and waste
* Successfully hire, supervise, train, and retain production/yard staff
* Evaluate and review employee’s performance for the purpose of determining skill level and training needs
* Coach and mentor employees to allow for increased responsibilities and career advancement. Lead by example.
* Promote and maintain a clean work environment
* Recommend purchases of additional equipment for efficiency, cost reductions and/or quality improvements
* Successfully work with Quality Control/Project Management to meet customer demand and expectations

new_roles.title: Director, Commercial Operations and Asset Management
new_roles.description:
**SUMMARY:** The Director, Commercial Operations & Asset Management provides leadership over the operational execution and ongoing asset management of Rhyze’s Commercial lending platform. This role is accountable for establishing scalable, controlled processes across transaction closing, funding, participation, servicing and portfolio administration, while actively overseeing the performance, credit quality and risk profile of the commercial real estate loan portfolio.

The Director leads portfolio surveillance, borrower and property performance monitoring, covenant compliance, annual review coordination, delinquency management and the operational execution of workout and loss mitigation strategies. The position works closely with the Managing Director, Commercial; Capital Markets; and Legal, and coordinates with lead lenders, borrowers, servicing partners and participating credit unions as appropriate.

The successful candidate combines commercial real estate credit and asset management expertise with operational discipline, sound judgment, strong communication skills and a focus on scalable execution.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Commercial Portfolio & Asset Management**

· Lead portfolio surveillance and risk-based monitoring of commercial real estate loans, including payment performance, DSCR, net operating income, occupancy, rent rolls, leasing, borrower liquidity, maturities and concentration exposure.

· Oversee borrower and property financial reporting, covenant testing and compliance calendars; identify reporting deficiencies, covenant breaches, emerging risks and required follow-up.

· Coordinate annual and interim credit reviews, risk-rating assessments, watchlist management and action plans, with documented findings, ownership, deadlines and management escalation.

· Oversee collateral protection requirements, including insurance, property taxes, escrows, reserves, liens, property inspections, appraisals and other third-party assessments, in coordination with Servicing and Legal.

**Special Assets & Loss Mitigation**

· Identify and escalate delinquencies, maturity or covenant defaults and deteriorating credits; coordinate borrower outreach, collection strategies and remediation plans for criticized or classified assets.

· Evaluate requests for waivers, modifications, extensions, forbearances and other accommodations; develop supporting analysis and recommendations for authorized decision-makers.

· Coordinate workout and loss mitigation activities with Commercial leadership, Legal and external counsel, including enforcement, bankruptcy or foreclosure matters when applicable.

· Prepare required participant notices and approval packages; document borrower communications, decisions, conditions and deadlines, and monitor execution and performance under approved resolution plans.

**Commercial Operations & Servicing Oversight**

· Lead day-to-day Commercial operations with clear accountability, service standards, quality controls and escalation procedures across the loan lifecycle.

· Oversee transaction closing, funding, loan boarding and post-closing administration, including conditions, documentation, milestone tracking, data transfers and outstanding exceptions.

· Coordinate with internal teams, servicing partners and Capital Markets on participation administration, payment processing, reconciliations, escrows, reserves, borrower notices, payoffs, releases and related servicing matters.

· Ensure accurate implementation and recording of approved modifications, extensions and other post-closing actions, consistent with loan documents, participation agreements, delegated authority and applicable requirements.

**Operational Excellence, Reporting & Scalability**

· Provide timely loan-level and portfolio reporting to management and participating investors, including delinquencies, covenant exceptions, watchlist activity, material credit events and remediation progress.

· Serve as a central coordinator across Commercial, Capital Markets, Finance, Legal, servicing partners, lead lenders and participating credit unions on operational and portfolio matters.

· Develop and standardize procedures, controls, checklists, templates and reporting; identify opportunities for automation, integration and improved data quality to support scalable growth.

· Establish and monitor key performance indicators, including reporting compliance, review completion, exception aging, delinquency trends, watchlist resolution and transaction cycle times.

**Other**· Responsible for effective self/workload management. Demonstrates clear written and verbal communication skills. Promotes collaboration and a positive, professional work environment. Attends all position related meetings to ensure proper communication/planning occurs.

· Performs other related duties as assigned by the Managing Director

· Complies with all company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

· Care for non-public information (NPI) and ensuring that confidentiality of company, borrowers, and partner information is maintained.

· Responsible for contributing to a positive work environment and culture that represents the company values.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

· Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience considered.

· Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in commercial real estate lending, commercial credit administration, loan servicing, asset management, or a related field, with demonstrated experience managing commercial loan portfolios.

· Strong understanding of the end-to-end commercial lending lifecycle, including loan documentation, closing, funding, servicing, portfolio administration, and loan participations.

· Demonstrated expertise in commercial real estate asset management, including financial statement analysis, property performance monitoring, debt service coverage, covenant compliance, collateral valuation, and credit risk assessment.

· Experience identifying and managing problem loans, including delinquencies, covenant defaults, borrower accommodations, forbearances, modifications, workouts, and loss mitigation strategies.

· Strong knowledge of commercial loan servicing practices, including payment administration, escrow and reserve management, collateral protection, and post-closing compliance.

· Demonstrated ability to evaluate portfolio performance, identify emerging credit risks, develop actionable recommendations, and effectively communicate findings to management and other stakeholders.

· Experience establishing and improving operational processes, internal controls, reporting practices, and technology-enabled workflows to support efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

· Strong understanding of commercial lending regulatory requirements, credit policies, risk management practices, and financial institution governance.

· Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate cross-functional activities, and lead complex initiatives with a high degree of accountability and attention to detail.

· Excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage borrowers, lending partners, credit union executives, and internal stakeholders.

· Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently in an entrepreneurial, growth-oriented environment.

Pay: $165,000.00 - $185,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Operations
new_roles.description:
We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions.

The Senior Director, Operations is a strategic operations leadership role responsible for scaling a $1.5B+ manufacturing campus and multi-site footprint through digital transformation, operational excellence, and high-impact leadership to enable accelerated growth and customer value. While this role carries responsibility for long-term operational strategy, digital transformation, capacity planning, and Smart Factory initiatives, the immediate mandate is centered on stabilizing and transforming one of nVent's most important manufacturing operations globally. The Anoka campus represents approximately $1.5 billion in annual revenue and employs roughly 1,700 people today, with expected growth toward 2,000 employees in the coming years. It is the largest manufacturing operation in the United States and the second-largest globally within nVent's manufacturing network.

 

Reporting directly to the Vice President, Integrated Supply Chain of the Systems Protection Segment, this role will have significant visibility across the organization and will play a critical role in shaping the future operating model of one of nVent's most strategically important manufacturing assets. Success in this role will create meaningful opportunities for broader enterprise leadership responsibility within nVent's global Integrated Supply Chain organization.

 

Key Responsibilities:

* Champion a high-performance continuous improvement culture by embedding Lean and problem-solving disciplines across all levels of the organization; empower employees to identify waste, implement solutions, and deliver sustainable gains while formally recognizing exceptional performance and contributions.
* Lead large-scale, multi-site operational transformation across a large scaled flagship campus and additional high-growth plants, ensuring alignment of capacity, capability, and talent strategies to support accelerated business growth and evolving customer demand.
* Drive Smart Factory / Digital Manufacturing advancement by scaling production capability through strategic investments in automation, advanced tooling, equipment, and data-driven systems (Industry 4.0), while balancing legacy operations with next-generation technologies to optimize throughput, quality, and cost.
* Own end-to-end operational performance across Operations, Procurement, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), Facilities, Material Handling, and Business Support functions, ensuring disciplined execution against safety, quality, delivery, cost, and cash flow objectives
* Develop and execute integrated strategic business plans that translate enterprise objectives into site-level actions, including long-range capacity planning, capital deployment (CapEx), workforce strategy, and footprint optimization across multiple locations.
* Serve as a key leader and cross-functional partner, collaborating with senior leadership, supply chain, engineering, and commercial teams to align short- and long-term operational strategies, remove constraints, and ensure successful new product introductions and business expansion.
* Lead, coach, and inspire a large, diverse organization by building strong leadership benches, strengthening succession pipelines, and fostering accountability, engagement, and inclusion across all functions and sites.
* Leverage data and operational analytics to drive decision-making, identifying bottlenecks, improving asset utilization (OEE), optimizing material flow, and prioritizing high-impact investments that enable scalability and profitability.
* Establish robust communication channels and employee engagement mechanisms to proactively monitor organizational health, gather feedback, and address concerns in partnership with Human Resources—ensuring a strong, transparent, and trust-based culture across all locations.
* Ensure world-class safety, compliance, and sustainability performance, reinforcing a zero-harm culture while maintaining adherence to environmental regulations, responsible sourcing practices, and corporate governance standards.
* Establish and sustain a rigorous management operating system across the campus, including daily management, tiered accountability processes, visual management, structured problem solving, and disciplined escalation practices that enable rapid identification and resolution of operational issues.
* Drive stabilization and performance improvement initiatives across critical manufacturing lines, ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, and productivity commitments while restoring operational predictability and customer confidence.
* Lead the continued development of a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, transparency, problem solving, and employee engagement, creating an environment where issues are surfaced early, addressed rapidly, and solved at their root cause.
* Evaluate and optimize material flow, production layout, workforce deployment, and capacity utilization across the campus, balancing immediate operational needs with long-term scalability requirements.
Partner closely with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Lean, Human Resources, and Finance leaders to strengthen organizational capability, improve execution, and ensure alignment around operational priorities and business objectives. 

 

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

* The ideal candidate will bring a BA or BS degree in Business, Engineering or similar field; MBA or other graduate degree is preferred.
* Deep understanding of lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies (TPM, Kaizen) within high-volume environments.
* Strong command of Smart Factory technologies, including IoT integration, predictive maintenance, automated material handling, and data-driven shop floor management.
* Comprehensive knowledge of EHS (Environmental, Health, and Safety) compliance, supply chain logistics, strategic procurement, and capital expenditure (CapEx) management.
* Expertise in long-range capacity planning, workforce strategy, and balancing the operational requirements of legacy product lines with the agility needed for new product introductions (NPI).
* Proficiency in P&L management, budget forecasting, and aligning plant-level performance metrics with enterprise-wide financial objectives.
* Ability to translate corporate strategy into actionable site-level plans and orchestrate cross-functional teams toward common goals.
* Demonstrated success in leading large-scale cultural and technical shifts, including the transition to digital manufacturing environments while maintaining stable output.
* Skill in leveraging operational analytics to identify bottlenecks, optimize production capability, and justify capital investments.
* Exceptional ability to foster open, transparent communication across all levels—from the shop floor to the executive boardroom—and effectively partner with Human Resources on organizational health.
* Proven ability to build, mentor, and inspire high-performing teams, fostering an environment of psychological safety and professional growth.
* Ability to navigate complex matrix organizations and collaborate effectively with stakeholders in Sales, Engineering, Finance, and HR to execute short- and long-term plans.
* Capacity to remain decisive and calm under pressure, managing the competing demands of high-growth production spikes, technical troubleshooting, and daily operational hurdles.•Ability to balance immediate, reactive operational needs with long-term, proactive improvements in infrastructure, tooling, and site facilities.
* Aptitude for cultivating a high-engagement, inclusive workplace that promotes active employee participation in problem-solving and recognizes performance excellence.

**WE HAVE:**

* A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day

 + nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.
 + Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com .

* Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work

 + We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide
 + Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money

==============

Join a team that puts its People First! First American's Agency Division is dedicated to providing our policy-issuing agents with resources, services and underwriting guidance needed to achieve new levels of success. Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

**What We Do**
==============

Provides strategic oversight for a major area of operations, setting direction, policies, and performance standards. Balance day-to-day performance with transformation, managing a large team through subordinate leaders.

**What You'll Do:**

 

* Implements goals, objectives, and work standards for the department.
* Applies policies and procedures that comply with regulatory and statutory guidelines, rules, and standards.
* Plans, organizes, administers, reviews, and evaluates the activities of professional, technical, and office support staff.
* Contributes to the overall quality of the department by developing and coordinating work teams and by reviewing, recommending, and implementing improved policies and procedures.
* Directs the selection of staff and provides for their training and professional development to maintain effective morale, productivity, and discipline.

**What You'll Bring:**

 

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

* 8+ years progressive management experience
* Demonstrated competency in executing strategic plans.
* Ability to learn needs of a wide range of employees while driving team performance, monitoring results and appropriately allocating resources.
* Possesses and applies a broad knowledge of principles, practices, and procedures of particular field of specialization to the completion of complex projects.
* Experience and knowledge of functional tools and infrastructure.
* Understanding of metrics/dashboards that drive an environment and culture of continuous improvement.
* Progressive experience in leading employees in multiple locations, and significant experience developing and implementing solutions.
* Possesses problem solving, collaboration, critical thinking, team building, and presentation skills.
* Results oriented and solution thinking with time management and project management skills.
* Displays leadership skills, leading by example, driving employee commitment through actions, and empowering employees to reach their full potential.

Pay Range: $129,300.00 - $172,300.00 Annually

By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. $110,000-$150,000 annually, plus performance bonuses

Houma, LA | Full-Time

As One Way AC and Electrical continues its rapid growth in residential and commercial HVAC, we're seeking an experienced **Head of Operations** to lead our expanding team, drive operational excellence, develop future leaders, and play a pivotal role in shaping the company's long-term success while building a rewarding career alongside us.

**Your Role:**

* Lead and inspire our service, installation, and operational teams.
* Build a culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and professional development.
* Create scalable processes that support company growth.
* Improve operational efficiency while maintaining exceptional customer experiences.
* Partner directly with ownership on strategic planning and future business initiatives.
* Help identify and develop future leaders within the organization.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Competitive base salary of $110,000-$150,000, based on experience.
* Performance bonuses and commission opportunities.
* Company-paid medical insurance covering 80% of employee premiums.
* Optional dental and vision insurance.
* 401(k) with up to a 3% employer match.
* Six paid holidays.
* Paid vacation that increases with tenure, plus two additional PTO days.
* Optional short-term and long-term disability coverage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Direct the daily operations of residential and commercial HVAC service and installation departments.
* Mentor managers, technicians, and support staff to maximize performance and career development.
* Monitor operational metrics and use data to improve productivity, profitability, and service quality.
* Ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest workmanship standards.
* Optimize scheduling, workflow, staffing, and resource allocation.
* Manage departmental budgets, labor costs, inventory, and operational expenses.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
* Champion an outstanding customer experience while maintaining high performance expectations.

**Required Qualifications**

* At least five years of experience within an HVAC company.
* Proven success overseeing residential and commercial HVAC operations.
* Strong knowledge of HVAC service, installation, and field operations.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and retain high-performing teams.
* Experience managing KPIs, financial performance, scheduling, and operational planning.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and decision-making skills.
* Familiarity with Service Titan or comparable HVAC management software is beneficial.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Building engaged, high-performing teams that consistently deliver outstanding results.
* Creating operational systems that support sustainable growth.
* Increasing efficiency, profitability, and overall business performance.
* Developing future leaders within the organization.
* Delivering an exceptional customer experience that strengthens Oneway AC's reputation.
* Helping drive the continued growth of one of the region's fastest-growing HVAC companies.

The Director of Operations is responsible for supporting the mission, vision and values of First Watch through all that he/she does in their role every day. The DO’s primary purpose is to develop General Managers and restaurant management teams to build and increase sales over the previous year and improve profitability, while ensuring employee and guest satisfaction, without compromising the integrity or You First culture of the concept. The Director of Operations is responsible for the success of all First Watch operations within their span of control (5-8 direct reports and 200-300 employees).

**Job Responsibilities**

* Leads operational activities for a group of First Watch Restaurants by performing the following in accordance with Company guidelines regarding management development, sales, and profitability, planning and customer and employee relations
* Trains, coaches and develops General Managers and Operations Managers, through timely performance and observation feedback and evaluations
* Follows up on training of MIT's/CAFE’s and hourly employees. Works closely with the Training General Manager to monitor progress
* Ensures development of Operations Managers within compliance of the FW management development programs
* Through effective manpower planning executes the continuous development of the management team and ensures timely and cost effective recruitment of restaurant level management and their training within First Watch
* Ensures the maintenance of a safe and harassment free workplace in all restaurants
* Takes quick and responsible action in solving problems and able to uses reason when dealing with individual or staff performance based issues to include personality conflicts
* Develops for prior approval and then meets or exceeds the area’s budget, including capital investments, General and Administrative expenses
* Promotes First Watch outside the restaurant

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent – concentration in food & beverage, business, marketing or management is preferred
* Five to seven years of progressive leadership experience in multi unit restaurant industry operations
* Proven track record of achieving results and building & maintaining successful teams
* Passion for providing excellent service and quality
* Ability to partner and build relationships while demonstrating leadership and integrity and promoting team success
* Extensive knowledge of the principles, procedures, and best practices in the industry
* Ability to work well under pressure in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel frequently within assigned market

new_roles.title: Regional Operations Director
new_roles.description:
### **Your Impact as a Regional Operations Director**

As a Regional Operations Director, you are a key leader responsible for the success and health of a diverse portfolio of veterinary hospitals. You will serve as the crucial link between local hospital teams and the broader Mission Pet Health network, empowering your teams to achieve excellence in both business performance and patient care.

* **Champion a Thriving Culture:** You'll partner with your Regional Medical Director to foster a positive, engaged, and high-performing culture across all hospitals in your region.
* **Develop Future Leaders:** You'll guide the growth of Hospital Managers and their teams, ensuring a strong pipeline of talent through effective coaching, training, and career development.
* **Drive Business Performance:** You'll have full ownership of the financial health of your region, managing P&Ls to drive revenue growth and optimize operational efficiency.
* **Build Winning Teams:** You'll lead the strategy for non-DVM recruiting and staffing, ensuring your hospitals have the talent they need to succeed.
* **Elevate the Client Experience:** You'll set the standard for exceptional client service, ensuring operational processes support a seamless and positive experience for every pet owner.

### **What You'll Bring to the Team**

* A proven track record of successful multi-site P&L management, with a keen ability to drive financial results.
* Demonstrated success in recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing teams, especially in a leadership capacity.
* Exceptional leadership skills with a talent for building a positive, accountable, and solutions-focused culture.
* Excellent communication and conflict management skills, with the ability to tailor messages to diverse audiences.
* Significant experience leading in a multi-site veterinary, healthcare, or customer-centric retail environment.

### **How You're Supported**

*As part of the Mission Pet Health family, you get the stability of a local practice backed by the comprehensive benefits and resources of a larger network. The focus is on investing in you, so you can focus on what you love.* 
 
*Note: Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you at every stage. Eligibility for specific benefits varies based on your role and hours worked.*

##### **Competitive Compensation**

A competitive hourly rate or salary based on your experience and role.

##### **Health & Wellbeing**

We offer comprehensive coverage options including Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, along with access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for all teammates.

##### **Financial Security**

Plan for your future with our 401k retirement options and additional financial protection benefits like Life Insurance and Disability coverage.

##### **Commitment to Growth**

We support your career goals with opportunities for professional development, including educational assistance for qualified teammates to enroll in AVMA-accredited veterinary technician programs.

##### **The Power of a Network**

Join a nationwide community of over 20,000 veterinary professionals who share a passion for collaboration, career growth, and sharing best practices.

##### **Valuable Perks**

Enjoy discounted veterinary care for your own pets, access to an online discount platform, and free 24/7 access to doctors through Teladoc.

### **About Mission Pet Health**

Mission Pet Health was founded by veterinarians on the belief that local practices thrive with clinical autonomy, collaboration, and medical excellence. The organization provides world-class support to its 850+ hospital teams on a hyper-local basis so they can focus on what matters most: the medicine, their patients, and their team culture. Learn more at **missionpethealth.com**.

Driving the award-winning culture are the WAG values – **Work Together, Amaze, and Grow**. Mission Pet Health is veterinarian-led, people-focused, and on a mission to be the best place to work in veterinary medicine. We are proud to be recognized as a 2025 "Most Loved Workplace," ranked #2 in America's Top 100 and #1 in veterinary care.

**Reasonable Accommodations:** Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation. Please contact benefits@mvetpartners.com with your request and contact information.

**EEO Statement:** Mission Pet Health is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

new_roles.title: Plant Operations Director
new_roles.description:
Barathaven Memory Care is now a part of the AgeWell Solvere Living family!
 
 
As a certified Great Place to Work for 8 years in a row , AgeWell Solvere Living proudly offers:
 
 

* Medical, Dental and Vision benefits
* Company-paid Life Insurance and Voluntary Disability
* Paid Time off and Holidays
* 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with company match

Barathaven Memory Care is a specialized senior living community located in the heart of Dardenne Prairie, Missouri. We are conveniently situated just minutes from O’Fallon and St. Charles, MO. Our beautiful, purpose-built community is designed to provide a safe, engaging, and supportive environment for individuals living with Alzheimer’s disease and other forms of dementia.
 
 
At Barathaven, we believe our team members are the key to creating meaningful experiences for our residents. Join our team and make a difference every day in a community that feels like home!
 
 
Role and Responsibilities
 
 

* Oversee the maintenance, repair, housekeeping, and overall physical plant operations of the community to ensure a safe, clean, attractive, and well-maintained environment for residents, visitors, and team members.
* Perform or coordinate general building maintenance, including electrical, plumbing, carpentry, painting, HVAC, and other facility-related repairs and services.
* Develop, implement, and monitor preventive maintenance programs for all building systems, equipment, grounds, and mechanical assets, ensuring timely identification and resolution of maintenance concerns.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, local, OSHA, life safety, fire safety, and assisted living regulations, including emergency preparedness and disaster response procedures.
* Oversee community safety initiatives, resident emergency response systems, incident reporting, safety committee activities, and the maintenance of required safety documentation and records.
* Manage maintenance contracts, vendor relationships, landscaping services, and outsourced providers to ensure quality performance and cost-effective service delivery.
* Maintain departmental budgets, invoices, supplies, purchased services, and labor expenses while promoting operational efficiency and responsible stewardship of community resources.
* Recruit, hire, train, schedule, coach, and evaluate Plant Operations and Housekeeping team members, fostering a culture of accountability, safety, customer service, and teamwork.
* Collaborate with community leadership and department managers to support resident satisfaction, operational excellence, community events, and organizational goals.

**Qualifications:** 

* Previous experience in plant operations, facility maintenance, or a related leadership role (healthcare or senior living environment preferred)
* Knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and building systems
* Understanding of OSHA, fire safety, and regulatory compliance
* Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills
* A commitment to serving seniors with respect and compassion:
